<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$integer = new class {
    public function __get(int|string $incoming): ?int {
        if ($incoming === "bad") {
            echo "ENTER;";
            return true;
        }
        if ($incoming === "12") {
            echo "NAME;";
            $incoming = false;
            return 7;
        }
        $incoming = false;
        return null;
    }
};
$floating = new class {
    public function __get(?string $incoming): ?float { return 9; }
};
$boolean = new class {
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): ?bool { return false; }
};
$string = new class {
    public function __get(string $incoming): ?string { return "kept"; }
};
$selector = "12";
echo $integer->$selector === 7 ? "INT;" : "BAD_INT;";
echo $integer->nil === null ? "NULL;" : "BAD_NULL;";
echo $floating->value === 9.0 ? "FLOAT;" : "BAD_FLOAT;";
echo $boolean->value === false ? "BOOL;" : "BAD_BOOL;";
echo $string->value;
echo ";";
$integer->nil;
$destination = 42;
try {
    $destination = $integer->bad === 7;
} catch (TypeError $failure) {
    echo $failure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "12" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_SELECTOR;";
echo "DONE;";
